name: jira
description: Query Jira issues, sprints and projects. Read-only (Jira Data Center v2 REST API).

base_url.title: Jira base URL
base_url.description: e.g. https://jira.internal.example.com - no trailing slash. REQUIRED.

projects.title: Project allowlist
projects.description: Optional. Comma-separated project keys, e.g. 'ABC,DEF'. When set, every tool is confined to them.

python.title: Python interpreter
python.description: Absolute path to the python.exe that has this server's pip dependencies installed (e.g. C:\Python311\python.exe). Use plain 'python' only if the right interpreter is first on PATH - a mismatch here is the most common cause of 'dependency missing' errors.
